title: Salesforce announces over 30 new features for Slack, including a meeting transcription feature and an operator mode to complete multi-step tasks on the desktop (Sabrina Ortiz/The Deep View)
summary: Sabrina Ortiz / The Deep View: Salesforce announces over 30 new features for Slack, including a meeting transcription feature and an operator mode to complete multi-step tasks on the desktop — For years, Slack has been where teams go to communicate. Now, it's setting its sights on something bigger …
